baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted possession construction is bounded by the upper domain at word 4 and the lower domain at word 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: The upper covering and the lower counterpart delimit a complete vertical field; the repeated indefinite relative assigns every contained entity in that field to one possessor.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies what rises and overshadows as the upper pole of an exhaustive spatial merism.
The branch supplies the lower realm opposite heaven, closing the merism so that possession covers the whole field.

changed_reading.before: God owns things located in heaven and on earth.
changed_reading.after: The clause maps an exhaustive vertical estate: upper cover, lower ground, and every entity held within their span are His.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated final epithets are anchored in elevation at word 9 and greatness at word 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: Elevation moves from physical height to rank and prevailing authority, while greatness contributes force and magnitude; after exhaustive possession, the pair describes an effective relation to the estate rather than two detached compliments.

activation_trace.role: Elevation as rank and honor converts spatial highness into unsurpassed standing over the possessed field.
Elevation as prevailing control gives the rank an operative relation of mastery rather than mere remoteness.
Greatness as magnitude and force supplies the scale and efficacy of that sovereignty.

changed_reading.before: The final words simply praise God as high and great.
changed_reading.after: The epithets qualify how the universal possessor stands over the whole field: unmatched in rank, prevailing control, scale, and force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The possessed vertical field becomes pressure-bearing rather than inert: its upper cover nearly opens by fracture, while praise and a plea for protective covering connect the upper attendants to inhabitants of the lower realm.

activation_trace.role: The overshadowing upper domain supplies the canopy that the next ayah presents as nearly splitting.
The lower realm supplies the opposite endpoint whose inhabitants become beneficiaries of the intervening plea.
Opening by fracture turns the upper boundary from a static location into a strained material surface.
Literal upper direction locates the strain above and sharpens the focus ayah's vertical architecture.
Protective covering of fault supplies the preserving function sought for those at the lower pole.

structural_cues: 42:5 immediately follows the focus, repeats heaven and earth, inserts angels between them, and sets fracture above against forgiveness sought for those below.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-fracture, upper direction, angelic praise, and forgiveness for earth's inhabitants; I connect them as stress and protective mediation across the focus merism. A live alternative is that 42:5 is an adjacent praise scene rather than an unpacking of ownership.

changed_reading.before: Heaven and earth form a static inventory under possession.
changed_reading.after: They form a sustained vertical order whose upper boundary strains and whose inhabitants are linked by praise, plea, and protective covering under the High and Great.

context_deltas.mechanism: Possession is activated as direct custody with control of access and calibrated allotment: guarding, standing over affairs, keys, expansion, apportioned provision, and constriction make the estate continuously administered.

activation_trace.role: The upper domain supplies one half of the estate later repeated immediately before its keys and provision are described.
The lower domain completes the estate whose access and resources are administered.
Guarding and watchful care turn belonging into ongoing custody rather than a bare title.
Standing directly over an affair frames the contrast between adopted patrons and the true administrator.
Keys that preserve and open what lies beneath them make ownership an access-control function.
Expansion as abundance supplies the outward setting of the estate's resource flow.
Provision as an apportioned gift identifies what is distributed through that controlled opening.
Constriction to a limited measure supplies the counter-operation to expansion.

structural_cues: 42:6 distinguishes divine guarding from the messenger's non-delegated role, 42:9 names God the true patron, and 42:12 repeats the heaven-earth pair before keys and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guarding, direct patronage, keys, expansion, allotment, and restriction; I infer that the focus possession entails active administration of access and flow. Alternatively, these may be separate examples of power rather than one custodial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Everything belongs to God as a settled fact.
changed_reading.after: Everything remains under direct custody: access is opened, resources are apportioned or narrowed, and no substitute patron inherits the administration.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal possession acquires a juridical function: disputed matters return for judgment, the human addressee is commanded to enact justice, and the revealed scale supplies a common measure.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing authority anchors why disputes within the possessed field can terminate at one superior jurisdiction.
Greatness as inviolable standing supplies the authority behind the shared standard.
Judgment between people makes the possessor the endpoint of disagreement.
Justice in judgment translates superior jurisdiction into a required human practice between parties.
The scale of justice supplies the measuring instrument by which claims inside the estate are assessed.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from returning disagreement to God at 42:10, through the command to judge justly at 42:15, to revelation of the scale at 42:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a return of disputes, commanded justice, and a revealed scale; I infer that exhaustive possession grounds jurisdiction and standard-setting. The alternative is that ethical judgment follows divine rank without being a semantic development of the possession clause.

changed_reading.before: The High and Great is sovereign in an unspecified sense.
changed_reading.after: His height and greatness function as final jurisdiction over the whole estate, with judgment transmitted downward as justice and measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation distributes mobile life through the two-domain field, while gathering reverses that dispersion; possession becomes continuous custody of multiplicity through both scattering and recollection.

activation_trace.role: The upper domain supplies one chamber across which created life is later said to be distributed.
The lower domain supplies the paired chamber, keeping the later distribution anchored in the focus merism.
A manifest sign marks the creation-and-gathering sequence as something to be read, not merely counted.
Bringing creation into being supplies the initiating operation within the possessed field.
Scattering supplies the outward movement from unity into distributed multiplicity.
Creeping motion on the ground gives the distributed contents independent-looking mobility.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the inverse operation and reveals retained command over every scattered part.

structural_cues: 42:29 repeats the focus's heaven-earth pair, then places creation, scattering of creatures, and possible gathering in one sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, dispersal, mobile creatures, and gathering; I read gathering as proof that dispersion never exits custody. A live alternative is that gathering names only a future event and does not redefine present possession.

changed_reading.before: The phrase inventories all existing occupants of two realms.
changed_reading.after: It claims every occupant across a managed cycle: brought forth, dispersed into motion, retained in custody, and gatherable again.

context_deltas.mechanism: Large visible vessels move only within a contingent kinetic system: willing, wind, stillness, destruction, and pardon can switch their motion and outcome. Greatness is recalibrated from apparent bulk to control of the forces on which bulk depends.

activation_trace.role: Magnitude and force provide the focus standard against which created largeness is recalibrated.
Flowing motion supplies the impressive created action whose dependency the next ayat expose.
A conspicuous guiding mark supplies the vessels' visible scale without granting them autonomous force.
Will attached to an outcome supplies the switch governing the scene's physical state.
Loss of motion supplies the direct reversal of the vessels' prior flow.
Wind as moving air supplies the unseen medium on which the large visible forms depend.
Being cast into destruction supplies one possible terminal outcome of the controlled motion.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault supplies the contrasting spared outcome.

structural_cues: 42:32-34 moves from flowing landmark-like ships to stilled wind, motionless hulls, destruction, or pardon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet directly links willing to wind and stillness, then gives destruction and pardon as outcomes; I map command of this kinetic dependency back to the focus epithet 'Great.' Alternatively, the ship scene may illustrate generic power without specifying the epithet's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Greatness primarily denotes superior size or abstract majesty.
changed_reading.after: Greatness is the ability to govern the hidden conditions of created scale, stopping massive motion or redirecting its outcome without sharing its bulk.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later near-repetition explicitly names dominion, then immediately exercises it through creating and gifting reproductive outcomes. Cosmic possession contracts to intimate contingency without changing owner or mechanism.

activation_trace.role: The upper realm anchors the cosmic scale of the possession formula later repeated before the reproductive list.
The lower realm completes the repeated formula and includes embodied household outcomes within its scope.
Dominion and sovereign power explicitly gloss the kind of belonging asserted by the focus construction.
Bringing into being converts dominion from title into generative action.
Gift without exchange makes sexed offspring an intimate allotment rather than an autonomous possession.
Joining one kind with another supplies the mixed reproductive outcome in the allocation set.
Infertility in womb and offspring supplies the withheld outcome, completing the range from gift to non-generation.

structural_cues: 42:49 nearly restates 42:4, inserts the explicit term for dominion, and continues through 42:50 with daughters, sons, both, or infertility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated cosmic formula followed by dominion, creation, gift, pairing, and infertility; I infer that the list operationalizes the focus possession at household scale. A live alternative is that offspring are only one example and do not define the earlier formula.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns remote cosmic ownership.
changed_reading.after: The same sovereignty reaches the most intimate contingencies of embodied life, allocating generation, combination, and withholding within the cosmic estate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Highness does not produce silence or disconnection: hidden conveyance, a barrier, and a messenger are controlled interfaces through which speech becomes light and guidance. The guided path then terminates in the return of all affairs, turning ownership into both source-side authority and destination.

activation_trace.role: Unsurpassed rank supplies the vertical distance that the closing communication sequence must cross without erasing.
Hidden conveyance of knowledge supplies a controlled mode by which high authority reaches a human recipient.
A screening barrier preserves separation while still participating in communication.
Messenger and message supply the mediated interface that carries communication across the preserved separation.
The repeated epithet explicitly seals the communication modes with elevation of rank rather than inaccessible distance.
Illumination turns the received communication into a medium that makes a route perceptible.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies directed movement generated by the transmitted light.
The straight road gives the communication an outbound human trajectory rather than leaving it as information.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the terminal return that closes the path.
Affairs and states supply what returns, extending the focus's possessed entities into their processes and outcomes.

structural_cues: 42:51 repeats the focus epithet of highness after three communication modes; 42:52 turns revelation into light and path; 42:53 repeats the focus possession formula and closes with all affairs tending to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mediated communication, repeated highness, light, guidance, path, the repeated possession clause, and final return; I connect them as descent of direction and return of affairs. Alternatively, the communication sequence and closing formula may be parallel affirmations rather than one circuit.

changed_reading.before: Highness places the universal owner remotely above the two realms.
changed_reading.after: Highness governs interfaces rather than causing absence: direction reaches the estate through mediated light, becomes a path, and carries every affair back to the owner as its destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant W-S-M mapping for the focus heaven-root rather than its ordinary lexical branch. It remains anchored because that supplied branch makes a visible mark and 42:29 explicitly presents the heaven-earth creation as a manifest sign; downstream prose should label it a consonantal branch activation, not a derivation or replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus occurrence at word 4 has a supplied split target whose branches concern visible marking and marks read as evidence.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark recasts the upper domain as a marked surface within the exploratory analogy.
A mark from which an observer infers a condition supplies the act of reading the cosmic domain evidentially.
The manifest sign explicitly licenses treating the repeated heaven-earth pair as evidence addressed to an observer.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are only the upper location included in possession.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the possessed heavens also behave as a marked sign-field whose visible condition identifies the authority that owns it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's S-M-M narrow-opening target for the focus heaven-root and must not be stated as the lexical meaning of 'heavens.' It remains worth carrying because 42:51 supplies hidden conveyance, barrier, and messenger as controlled access modes under repeated highness; render it only as a material analogy for selective communication across cosmic separation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus occurrence at word 4 has a supplied split target whose first branch is a narrow opening through which something enters.

activation_trace.role: A narrow aperture supplies the exploratory material image of selective passage through the upper boundary.
Hidden delivery of knowledge supplies what passes through the controlled communicative interface.
A screening barrier supplies the boundary whose access remains selective rather than open.
Messenger and message supply a licensed carrier through the otherwise preserved separation.

changed_reading.before: The high owner is separated from the cosmic domains by distance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the upper boundary is not simply distance but a controlled interface with selective apertures for hidden knowledge and licensed messengers.

strongest_changes: The static heaven-earth inventory became an administered field of custody, access, provision, and measure.
The repeated formula at 42:49 carried cosmic sovereignty into intimate reproductive allocation.
Creation, scattering, and gathering at 42:29 turned possession into custody across a reversible multiplicity.
The repeated highness at 42:51 and closing reprise at 42:53 made mediated guidance and the return of affairs a single directional arc.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reopened the same compact focus formula at different scales: stressed cosmic structure, legal measure, ecology and motion, household generation, communication, path, and final return. The exact reprises at 42:49 and 42:53 made these changes more than loose thematic association.
remaining_uncertainties: The pressure-and-cover reading of 42:5 may be a close sequential activation rather than a direct mechanism of possession.
The return at 42:53 can be read administratively, eschatologically, or both; the packet does not force one temporal scope.
The marked-heaven and aperture models depend on supplied split-root branches and must remain exploratory analogies rather than lexical claims.
